data.name: Hammer
data.long_meaning: The name Hammer is derived from the Old English word 'hamor', meaning 'a heavy striking tool'. The name carries the connotation of strength, power, and the ability to shape or break things.
data.spiritual_meaning: In spiritual terms, the name Hammer represents the power of God to shape and mold our lives, and the strength we need to overcome challenges and obstacles.
